features: raw haplotype and diploid-state length spectra; threshold5/10cM chromosome-wise homolog minor-sharing fractions and lengths after IBD2 masking; IBD2 fraction
ablation: otherwise identical classifier excludes homolog minor-sharing features but retains explicit IBD2 fractions
phase_invariance: sample-order swap and independent homolog swaps within each chromosome; interval unions prevent duplicate counting
training_detectability_approximation: exact ancestral haplotype edges below2cM omitted; this does not model complete detection uncertainty
calibration_rule: select scalar temperature minimizing class-balanced negative log loss on only the four new detected development cohorts; deterministic lowest-temperature tie break
confirmation_execution_gate: Only after development reaches complete coverage,0.80exact,0.70macro,0.50minimum-label-recall,+0.10gain over frozen baseline and no cohort regression; source/model/calibration freeze before confirmation
rng: Founder ancestry, mutation and hypothetical dropout use NumPy SeedSequence([cohort_seed,chromosome,stage]); Ped-sim uses stage3/chromosome0. Derived seeds recorded before generation, checked unique over all planned cohorts/stages.
existing_diagnostic_data_policy: original18person and both prior mixed-depth families excluded from fitting and calibration; repeated founder RNG seeds in prior mixed families prohibit independence claims
budget: one exact-phased training job (4CPU,30minutes); four detected development families(4CPU,60minute limits); at most four confirmation families if gates pass
limitations: rooting uncertainty unresolved by composite pair probabilities
